entry.title: Sewer Commission: the meeting of 8 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Sewer Commission voted to seek a combined multi-year pump station O&M/construction contract for Nov. town meeting. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VMfaXMyKBII), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
